definitions.explanation: An error or fault on one's own part — something for which one should accept responsibility. Most often appears in the fixed expression {非|ひ}を{認|みと}める (to admit one's fault).

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{非|ひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}めた→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。

examples.english: He is not at fault in any way.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{非|ひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{責|せ}める→責める：02284_semeru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{非|ひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{反省|はんせい}した→反省する：21398_hanseisuru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: Before blaming the other party for their fault, you should reflect on your own.

notes:
Used as a standalone noun mainly in set expressions. The same kanji also serves as a productive prefix meaning 'non-' or 'un-' (e.g., ⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧, ⟦{非公開|ひこうかい}→非公開：16599_hikoukai⟧), but that prefix use is separate from this noun sense.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {非|ひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧: admit one's fault
- {非|ひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{詫|わ}びる→詫びる：14174_wabiru⟧: apologize for one's fault
- {非|ひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{責|せ}める→責める：02284_semeru⟧: blame (someone) for their fault
- {非|ひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: be without fault
- ⟦{是非|ぜひ}→是非：19460_zehi⟧: right and wrong (set compound)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{過|あやま}ち→過ち：14376_ayamachi⟧: error, mistake — broader; covers any kind of error
- {落|お}ち{度|ど}: oversight, failing — focuses on a slip in one's duty
- ⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧: responsibility — covers what one ought to bear, including for one's {非|ひ}
